mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM CONSUMPTION_ANALYSIS_RESULTS ORDER BY user_id

SELECT analysis_result_id AS analysisResultId, user_id AS userId, calculated_result AS calculatedResultJson FROM CONSUMPTION_ANALYSIS_RESULTS WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY generated_at DESC, analysis_result_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DAILY_MISSIONS (user_id, assigned_date, display_order, title, description, category, reward_point, verification_type, verification_rule, evidence_guide, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{assignedDate}, #{displayOrder}, #{title}, #{description}, #{category}, #{rewardPoint}, #{verificationType}, #{verificationRuleJson}, #{evidenceGuide}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT daily_mission_id AS dailyMissionId, user_id AS userId, assigned_date AS assignedDate, display_order AS displayOrder, status, completed_at AS completedAt, title, description, category, reward_point AS rewardPoint, verification_type AS verificationType, evidence_guide AS evidenceGuide, verification_rule AS verificationRuleJson FROM DAILY_MISSIONS WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND assigned_date = #{assignedDate} ORDER BY display_order
SELECT MAX(assigned_date) FROM DAILY_MISSIONS WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT daily.daily_mission_id AS dailyMissionId, daily.user_id AS userId, daily.assigned_date AS assignedDate, daily.status, daily.title, daily.description, daily.verification_type AS verificationType, daily.verification_rule AS verificationRuleJson, daily.evidence_guide AS evidenceGuide, daily.reward_point AS rewardPoint, feed.media_url AS mediaUrl, feed.media_type AS mediaType, analysis.analysis_summary AS analysisSummary, analysis.estimated_saving_amount AS estimatedSavingAmount FROM DAILY_MISSIONS daily JOIN FEED feed ON feed.id = #{feedId} AND feed.user_id = daily.user_id AND feed.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN FEED_ANALYSIS analysis ON analysis.feed_id = feed.id AND analysis.analysis_summary IS NOT NULL WHERE daily.daily_mission_id = #{dailyMissionId} AND daily.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT daily_mission_id AS dailyMissionId, user_id AS userId, assigned_date AS assignedDate, status, title, description, category, reward_point AS rewardPoint, verification_type AS verificationType, verification_rule AS verificationRuleJson, evidence_guide AS evidenceGuide FROM DAILY_MISSIONS WHERE daily_mission_id = #{dailyMissionId} AND user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MISSION_VERIFICATIONS WHERE daily_mission_id = #{dailyMissionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MISSION_VERIFICATIONS (daily_mission_id, feed_id, attempt_number, decision, confidence_score, reason, model_version) VALUES (#{dailyMissionId}, #{feedId}, #{attemptNumber}, #{decision}, #{confidenceScore}, #{reason}, #{modelVersion})
